lines.en: label halloweenfive3:
scene chikayumihallow1
: Hey...I didn’t...realize you’d be coming this year.
: And I didn’t realize you were capable of talking to me without threatening my life anymore.
scene chikayumihallow2
: Yeaaaaah...sorry about that. That was a...weird thing that happened.
: I ain’t sure “weird” really summarizes it, but aight.
: I feel like I’m missing valuable context here.
scene chikayumihallow3
: I feel like it might be time for you to fuck off, nerd.
: Weren’t you just telling me a minute ago that making people feel small doesn’t feel good? What happened to the big sentimental moment we just had?
: Beats me, four-eyes. I gotta make time for another one I guess.
: Four-eyes? But I’m not even wearing my glasses today.
: Sorry, Makoto...can I borrow Yumi for a minute? I get that you guys are still decorating and stuff, so I promise it won’t take long.
scene chikayumihallow4
: Just keep her. Yumi wasn’t really helping at all and we’re practically done here anyway.
: Uhh...okay. Sorry again, though.
: I ain’t gonna follow you just to get the shit kicked out of me, am I? Cause I get that you hate me and whatnot now, but fuckin’ me up on my birthday seems like a bit of a low blow.
scene chikayumihallow5
: Oh, crap. I totally forgot it was your birthday.
: Good. Why are you still here?
: You’re in my way. I need to finish setting up the second jack-o-lantern. And if it’s not absolutely perfectly positioned, I will consider myself a failure for the rest of eternity. Literally.
: Come on, Yumi. We can talk outside. I promise I won’t try to throw you off of a building this time.
: Just what the hell happened between you two?
scene black
: A whole lotta bullshit, that’s what. But hey, here’s hopin’ the universe makes me forget it or whatever.
: Also, since I kinda fear for my life right now, you don’t happen to know what goes down when somebody dies in this shit, do you?
: I’m not sure. Let me call my dad and find out.
: Oh, fuck. Sorry.
: What are you guys talking about? I don’t get it.
: Yeah, you wouldn’t. Come on.
: Let’s get this shit over with.
scene chikayumihallow6
Back outside, where the light still lives — two friends (?) find their places among the foliage.
But the birthday girl is apprehensive. Because despite being accustomed to the ones she loves abandoning her, she isn’t used to them coming back so quickly.
Something had changed within Chika, though. And it was this thought that made her entirely uncertain whether or not she even was coming back.
She was flashing her those same sympathetic, caring eyes she always had. But words like “whore” still lingered in the back of her mind and made her feel both regretful and dirty.
She hadn’t done anything wrong yet. But she understood that the mere possibility of doing something wrong made her actions (or inactions) wrong to Chika.
Yumi agreed — which is why she wouldn’t put up a fight if her former (or current?) friend really did want to give her a birthday beatdown.
That friend (?) had other plans, though.
scene chikayumihallow7
Her disease had already set in by now. She’d never again be able to swallow the sea as the mere thought of water made her foam from the mouth.
As she’d started showing symptoms, it was already too late for her. But she could still infect others. She could take her friend (?) down with her.
She bares her teeth and prepares to sink her fangs in.
: Let me start off by saying I am so sorry for the way I treated you, Yumi.
But she sinks them in gently. Gentle enough to not signal to the birthday girl that she’s been bitten.
: You’re...what?
: Sorry. I went way overboard back at the apartment. It was the culmination of a lot of anxiety I’ve been having lately and...knowing it was you just sent me over the edge.
: I love you, Yumi. Seriously.
scene chikayumihallow8
: Is there some kinda catch here? Because-

: No! Nothing like that. I just...didn’t really understand what was happening back then. But I’ve had time to think about it now, and I get it. You were never trying to hurt me. You were just confused.
: I’m confused now too. The fuck did that creeper say to you that made you flip-flop like it was fuckin’ nothing?

: You said it yourself that even if I was tellin’ the truth that shit wasn’t lookin’ good for me. And you were right. A hundred fuckin’ percent. I screwed up by lettin’ myself get close to that guy. Ain’t no way around it.
: You didn’t screw up, Yumi. Some people just have different ideas of what “love” really is.
: Some people...what?
scene chikayumihallow9
: Think of it like this — monogamy hasn’t always been expected or even normal in society. In fact, love and sex were practically unlinked at first. Some say even the gods themselves got around.
: Are you fuckin’ high right now? The hell are you on about?
: You’re not listening. This is me admitting that I’ve been looking at things all wrong. I expected everyone else to think of love the same way I did, but it’s been me who’s been wrong.
: With so many wonderful people all over the world and so many things to love about each and every one of them, of course loving just one person would be wrong. It doesn’t make sense.
: There are all different types of love out there and not all of them are created equally. All pigeonholing someone into ignoring those other feelings does is make them think you’re undeserving.
scene chikayumihallow10
: Life is a learning experience, Yumi. You can never really grow until you start seeing things from other people’s perspectives.

: So I get it now. And I feel totally ridiculous for ever questioning Sensei in the first place. I just didn’t see at the time how many different ways to love there were. But now that I do, I’m a better person.
: I’m beginnin’ to think that motherfucker didn’t even show up and you’ve just been left in your apartment to rot and go insane since then.
scene chikayumihallow11

: It’s okay. You don’t have to understand it right now. You’re still inexperienced. But take it from me — love only seems complicated at first, but it’s actually really simple. And that’s why I forgive you.
: Uhh...I still ain’t really got a fuckin’ clue what you’re tryin’ to say here, but...so long as you’re sayin’ we’re on good terms again, I...guess it doesn’t really matter?
scene chikayumihallow12
: Right.
: And also why you can go ahead and pursue Sensei in any way you want since I know that his love for me is the strongest.
scene chikayumihallow13
: The fuck you mean “pursue” him?! That shit sounds like you’re tryin’ to hook me up with the guy!
: I mean, I’m not trying to. But if your feelings for one another are strong enough to be considered “love” by any stretch, I no longer see a problem with it!
: Please tell me you hid your fuckin’ drugs from Chinami because this shit is scary, Chika.
scene chikayumihallow14

: It’s not scary, it’s just different. Sensei told me very clearly that he would choose me over anyone if he really had to. And I believe him because that’s what love is. It’s just “love” for everyone else.
: Love and “love” are the same fuckin’ word, dumbass.
: Same word — different meanings.
scene chikayumihallow15
: If it helps you understand, why not look at Sensei like a god and me as his goddess?! As deities together, we love all of our subjects! We just love each other the most!
: Did he fuckin’ brainwash you?...You seriously ain’t got a problem with that, Chika? That’s totally different from literally everything you’ve ever-
scene chikayumihallow16
: I wasn’t brainwashed. I’ve just grown. And sometimes, when people grow, they start looking at the world a little differently.
: You’ll get there one day, Yumi. You’re an amazing girl and I’m positive that one day, you’ll find your own Sensei.
: But until then, you can let mine share some of his infinite love with you.
: Gtyrfngroffmymth.
scene chikayumihallow17
: Sorry.
: Without beatin’ around the bush...you’re suddenly okay with your “boyfriend” fucking other girls?
: Only if he loves them.
: Well, how the fuck do you know if he loves them?
: By trusting him, obviously.
scene chikayumihallow18
: Chika, you’re fucking delusional!
: Don’t call me delusional just because you aren’t mature enough to understand love yet! You’ve gotta remember, I was also like that until recently!
: Yeah! But now you’ve gone and snapped and rewritten everything you’ve ever thought about love over some shit that asshole said to you!
: Hey, don’t call Sensei an asshole when you two have practically already had sex behind my back!
: We have fucking not!
scene chikayumihallow19
: But now you can! And everyone wins — especially me since I’m winning.
: Winning what?
: Sensei, obviously. I’m his number one girl and the one he loves the most. And one day, we’re going to get married and have a bunch of kids and live happily ever after. The end.
scene chikayumihallow20
: Now, let me tell you how he likes his dick sucked so you don’t embarrass yourself the first time you try. You can start by-
: I don’t want to hear it...
scene black
: Yumi? Where are you going?
: Back inside. I came out here to talk to Chika, not whoever the fuck this is.
: I’m still me! I just have a new lease on life! Don’t you want to learn how to give a blowjob?!
scene chikayumihallow21
: Ya ever wonder why Ayane’s got so many friggin’ Halloween decorations? There’s some stuff in here that’s weird as heck.
: I’ve found like fifteen guns already.
: That’s it? Figured there would be more.
: Sixteen, actually. I can see a pistol inside of this pumpkin now that I’m looking a little closer.
: Friggin’ rich people, man. Always heard money buys power, but I didn’t think that was about actual weapons.
scene chikayumihallow22
: It is what it is. At least we can be happy that she’s a responsible gun owner.
: She brings them to school.
: Yeah, but every single one of her murders has been with some sort of ball.
: Speakin’ of balls, you ever break your vagina before?
scene chikayumihallow23
: I’m sorry?
: Like by puttin’ somethin’ up there way too big for it. Pretty normal thing, I hear. Happens to like nine out of ten girls.
: I mean...is that really breaking it, though?
: Oh, yeah. Blood everywhere. Constant pain. Hurts to pee for the next week. You know how it is, right?
: Uhh...
: Is everything okay, Miku? Did you...somehow break your vagina? Do you...require medical assistance?
: Me? Pfft. No. I’m Monkey D. Luffy. No vagina here. Just a cool hat and a stretchy wiener.
scene chikayumihallow24
: You’re a weird girl. But I won’t lie — it’s been fun getting to know you a little better today. Even if some of your questions have been extremely unconventional and oddly personal.
: Yeah. We ain’t ever really talked much, have we?
: Not about anything deep, at least. But it’s not like we need to know everything about one another to become-
scene chikayumihallow25
: Huh?
: How do we become “huh” exactly? I ain’t sure what that means.
: Sorry. What I meant to say was, “Huh? There’s a box in here with Ami’s name on it.”
scene chikayumihallow26
: Ami? What’s in it? Somebody’s intestines? Strawberry milk? Pictures of Sensei? Move over. I can’t see.
: Looks like it’s pictures of...
scene chikayumihallow27
: Us? Lemme see. My clothes are on, right? Cause I’m chargin’ for nudes.
: That’s...so weird...
: I don’t remember taking any of these...
: The heck are you wearin’ there? I don’t recognize that costume.
: Yeah...neither do I.
scene chikayumihallow28
: Well hello, Molly. Hello, Tsuneyo. Please do not mind me. I’m just looking at the ceiling for no reason whatsoever.
: You sure are...fit, Tsuneyo. I wish I had the confidence or body to wear something like that.
: We can’t all be perfect. I apologize for my existence and how it may intimidate you.
: You’ll be the talk of the evening, Kendo Princess. I am now intimately familiar with your body and promise only the best in MacCormack creations from this point on!
: Intimately...familiar...
: If only it meant what you want it to mean, Nithhala. If only.
: So I assume you have...no clue who you’re dressed up as. Do you, Tsuneyo.
: I have been advised that my character’s name is “Jade” from a video game titled “Moral Combat.”
: Mortal. And it’s Kombat with a K. Not a C.
scene chikayumihallow29
: How can you even tell the-
scene chikayumihallow30
: Oh my fucking god. I forget what I was even saying.
: Likely something about how impressive my skills are. And how they continue to improve with each passing Halloween.
: I no longer prefer Kitana.
: You really have been improving, Molly. Though, I would like to ask why you’re the only one of our cosplay group this Halloween who’s dressed in casual clothes as opposed to combat ones.
scene chikayumihallow31
: Futaba’s combat clothes are just so boring!
: That’s very rude to say directly to her face.
: They’re totally unnecessary too since she never even engages in combat!
: Your defamatory barrage continues despite the fact that it puts one of your friendships in jeopardy. I implore you to reconsider, even if you are correct.
: Oh my fucking god...
: Can’t I just wear these instead? Form-fitting clothes don’t look good on me when I have zero form to begin with.
: I don’t have a problem with it. It’s only fair that you use Halloween as an excuse to dress up as whatever character you want since you’re the one who makes all of our costumes in the first place.
: Maybe...don’t sexualize Tsuneyo as much next year, though.
scene chikayumihallow32
: My entire existence is sexual. I am lust incarnate. I am the Mortal Wombat.
: Kombat. And you’re not opposed to dressing this way — are you, Jade?
: Not at all. I exist to be praised and worshipped.
: I was thinking less of Tsuneyo herself and...more of the danger it puts Rin in. She looks like she’s about to pass out.
: Oh my fucking god...
scene chikayumihallow33
: She won’t be in danger much longer at least. Tsuneyo isn’t going to be with us for most of the party.
: What?! No! She can’t leave! I have to...discuss things with her! About...uhh...noodles?
: As tempting as that offer may be, I have come here today to hone my skills as a cook and will be spending the evening in the kitchen.
: Ayane’s butler is apparently a world renowned chef and has agreed to power-level Tsuneyo’s cooking.
: The Emerald Guardian has even provided me with special “heirloom underwear” that will boost my XP by 10%%.
scene chikayumihallow34
: They don’t need to know about that part, Kendo Princess.
: Molly...what are you making Tsuneyo wear beneath her costume?
: Yeah! Show us! It’s only fair!
: See? This is why I told you to keep that part a secret.
scene black
: I apologize for my insubordination. I am no longer deserving of the heirloom underwear. I shall remove them now.
: N-Not in the middle of the room! What do you think you’re doing?!
: No, what do you think you’re doing?! Don’t stop her! Molly, help me hold Futaba back!
: Roger! Engaging vice grip!
: Tsuneyo! No stripping in the middle of the party! Rin! Molly! What do you think you’re-
: Phantom Thieves! Palace security has reached 99%%! We’re about to be kicked from the dungeon!
: They removed that in Royal! If we turn back the clock, I literally won’t exist anymore!
